name: Index YouTube Playlist

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index:
    name: Run YouTube indexing
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: youtube-index-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
      VECTORIZE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.VECTORIZE_API_KEY }}
      R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      R2_BUCKET_NAME: ${{ secrets.R2_BUCKET_NAME }}
      # Add any other environment variables required by the indexer
      # e.g., PLAYLIST_ID, VECTORIZE_ENDPOINT, etc.
      # These can be defined in the repo's .env or package.json scripts
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run YouTube indexing script
        run: |
          # If the project uses a npm script, replace the command below
          # with `npm run index-youtube` or the appropriate script name.
          # Otherwise, run the TypeScript file directly.
          if npm run | grep -q "index-youtube"; then
            npm run index-youtube
          else
            npx ts-node src/index-youtube-playlist.ts
          fi
        env:
          # Pass through all env vars defined above
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ env.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          VECTORIZE_API_KEY: ${{ env.VECTORIZE_API_KEY }}
          R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          R2_BUCKET_NAME: ${{ env.R2_BUCKET_NAME }}

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: youtube-index-logs
          path: logs/*.log
